resources.string: Contacts, people you wrote to and senders of a verification code stay in Messages.
Only senders you block go to Spam.
You can change this later in Settings.
Every text goes to Messages. Only senders you block go to Spam.
On: unknown senders go to Spam
Off: everything arrives in Messages, except senders you blocked

plurals.name: pt_filter_off_confirm_body
plurals.item: %d chat moves from Spam to Messages. Chats of senders you blocked stay in Spam.
%d chats move from Spam to Messages. Chats of senders you blocked stay in Spam.

plurals.name: pt_filter_on_confirm_body
plurals.item: %d chat from an unknown sender moves to Spam. Nothing is deleted.
%d chats from unknown senders move to Spam. Nothing is deleted.

plurals.name: pt_purge_warn_body
plurals.item: Texts that arrived in Spam more than %d day ago are deleted from the phone itself, for every app. They cannot be brought back. Texts you sent, starred or added a note to stay.
Texts that arrived in Spam more than %d days ago are deleted from the phone itself, for every app. They cannot be brought back. Texts you sent, starred or added a note to stay.

resources.string: A sender that sends you a verification code is allowed from then on. Remove it here, or block it in its chat.
A number you send a text to is allowed from then on. Remove it here, or block it in its chat.

plurals.name: pt_group_off_body
plurals.item: %d chat moves to Spam. The senders stay on the list and come back when you turn it on again.
%d chats move to Spam. The senders stay on the list and come back when you turn it on again.

resources.string: After that, a verification code from an unknown sender goes to Spam too.
Would go to Messages: the sender is in “%1$s”.
Would go to Messages: the text has one of your allowed words. The sender is then allowed.
Would go to Spam: the text has one of your blocked words. The sender is then blocked.
This runs once. No chat moves before it is finished, and nothing is deleted.
Moving older spam to the phone
The spam filter is now one switch: on or off.
Your rules now cover both SIMs.
Older spam is now stored on the phone itself, like every other text.
Auto-delete of old spam is off. You can turn it on in Settings.
